function: Learned joint choice of AAV target positions, UD offloading choices and RIS phase shifts to minimize maximum task execution time; ratios and resources by local search (pp. 10-12).
system: 40 ground UDs, 3 BSs, 3 AAVs each carrying a reflecting RIS with 16 elements; antennas and carrier band not stated; OFDMA, 5 MHz (pp. 4-5, 12).
method: Multitask double DQN (MTDDQN) with three sub-action heads and weighted loss, trained by reinforcement learning with the digital twin; ratios and resources by alternating local search (pp. 10-12).
data_channel: Custom simulator: distance path loss (exponent 2.2), Rician fading (factor 10), cascaded RIS channel, 1000 m x 1000 m area; no dataset or measurements (pp. 5-6, 12).
test_conditions: Trained and evaluated in one simulated environment; sweeps over UDs, AAVs, bandwidth, task volume, BS computing, DT deviation; no test in an unseen scenario is stated (pp. 12-15).
baselines: ERF, BOS, OR (offloading-ratio or resource variants), RPS (random RIS phases); learned: standard DQN in place of MTDDQN (p. 13).
metrics: Maximum task execution time, total task execution time, normalized reward convergence (pp. 12-15).
q1_support: p. 6: "Rician channel link is dominated between Rk and Um"; custom distance-based path-loss and Rician simulator with Table I parameters (p. 12). No 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured channel is mentioned, so a standard channel is missing.
q2_support: p. 13: "UDs is 30, 40, and 50, respectively"; each setting has its own convergence curve and the DT-deviation sweep (p. 15) varies one parameter, so no model trained in one scenario is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 13: "Random Phase Shift (RPS): We incorporate a random" phase shift design (non-learned) and "We utilize the DQN algorithm as an alternative" to MTDDQN; Figs. 5-6 (pp. 13-14) compare maximum and total execution time.
q4_support: p. 6: "we neglect the execution time of the algorithm"; the paper reports no complexity order, operation count, parameter count or measured runtime for MTDDQN or the alternating algorithm.
q5_support: p. 12: "40 UDs are randomly distributed"; the experiments use a self-built simulation (Table I), with no code or data link, no public channel dataset and no measured data.
notes: Included under the rule that a work learning a physical-layer decision jointly with one above it passes above_phy: the MTDDQN action holds the RIS phase shifts (a3, p. 10) next to AAV positions and offloading choices, while ratios and compute allocation are not learned (local search, p. 12). Area 6 chosen because the RIS is carried by AAVs (aerial links, more specific than area 3); by function the alternative is area 3 (RIS phase shifts). The objective is task execution time and no radio metric is reported. q3: RPS is the non-learned baseline; DQN is the standard algorithm that MTDDQN extends, so the reviewer may treat it as an ablation. Table I lists the Rician factor as 10 dm (probably dB) and no carrier frequency.
